metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Reykjavík show higher values compared to the Snæfellsnes peninsula in 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS daily collection (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1 or NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2) - Date: 2016 (full year to get good coverage at high latitude) - Location: Two regions - Reykjavík (capital city) and Snæfellsnes peninsula (rural area) - VIIRS data started in 2012, so 2016 should have data 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS nighttime lights don't need cloud masking in the same way - Use quality flags if available, but primarily focus on getting valid NTL values - Average over the year to get representative values 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Rural areas can legitimately have near-zero nighttime lights (Answer B if Reykjavík ≤ Snæfellsnes) - Null/Error (C3): If results are None or NaN - C1: No images found - C2: No valid pixels after processing - Answer A if Reykjavík > Snæfellsnes (expected for city vs rural) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Reykjavík center (capital city) reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.8952, 64.1466]) reykjavik_region = reykjavik.buffer(5000) # 5km buffer # Snæfellsnes peninsula (rural area, northwest of Reykjavík) snaefellsnes = ee.Geometry.Point([-23.7764, 64.8569]) snaefellsnes_region = snaefellsnes.buffer(5000) # 5km buffer # 2. Data Acquisition # Using VIIRS VNP46A2 (gap-filled, BRDF corrected) collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2') \ .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31') \ .select('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL') # Check Reykjavík col_reyk = collection.filterBounds(reykjavik_region) size_reyk = col_reyk.size().getInfo() # Check Snæfellsnes col_snaef = collection.filterBounds(snaefellsnes_region) size_snaef = col_snaef.size().getInfo() print(f"Reykjavík Images: {size_reyk}") print(f"Snæfellsnes Images: {size_snaef}") if size_reyk == 0 or size_snaef == 0: print("No data for one or both regions in 2016.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Calculate mean NTL for each region mean_reyk_img = col_reyk.mean() mean_snaef_img = col_snaef.mean() # Get pixel counts count_reyk = mean_reyk_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=reykjavik_region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo() count_snaef = mean_snaef_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=snaefellsnes_region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo() print(f"Reykjavík Valid Pixels: {count_reyk}") print(f"Snæfellsnes Valid Pixels: {count_snaef}") if count_reyk == 0 or count_snaef == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") else: # Calculate mean NTL values ntl_reyk = mean_reyk_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=reykjavik_region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo() ntl_snaef = mean_snaef_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=snaefellsnes_region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo() print(f"Reykjavík Mean NTL: {ntl_reyk}") print(f"Snæfellsnes Mean NTL: {ntl_snaef}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if ntl_reyk is None or ntl_snaef is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid results.") print("C3") elif ntl_reyk > ntl_snaef: print(f"Reykjavík ({ntl_reyk:.4f}) > Snæfellsnes ({ntl_snaef:.4f})") print("A") else: print(f"Reykjavík ({ntl_reyk:.4f}) ≤ Snæfellsnes ({ntl_snaef:.4f})") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Reykjavík center (capital city)
reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.8952, 64.1466])
reykjavik_region = reykjavik.buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer

# Snæfellsnes peninsula (rural area, northwest of Reykjavík)
snaefellsnes = ee.Geometry.Point([-23.7764, 64.8569])
snaefellsnes_region = snaefellsnes.buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer

# 2. Data Acquisition
# Using VIIRS VNP46A2 (gap-filled, BRDF corrected)
collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2') \
    .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31') \
    .select('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL')

# Check Reykjavík
col_reyk = collection.filterBounds(reykjavik_region)
size_reyk = col_reyk.size().getInfo()

# Check Snæfellsnes
col_snaef = collection.filterBounds(snaefellsnes_region)
size_snaef = col_snaef.size().getInfo()

print(f"Reykjavík Images: {size_reyk}")
print(f"Snæfellsnes Images: {size_snaef}")

if size_reyk == 0 or size_snaef == 0:
    print("No data for one or both regions in 2016.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate mean NTL for each region
    mean_reyk_img = col_reyk.mean()
    mean_snaef_img = col_snaef.mean()
    
    # Get pixel counts
    count_reyk = mean_reyk_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=reykjavik_region,
        scale=500,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo()
    
    count_snaef = mean_snaef_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=snaefellsnes_region,
        scale=500,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Reykjavík Valid Pixels: {count_reyk}")
    print(f"Snæfellsnes Valid Pixels: {count_snaef}")
    
    if count_reyk == 0 or count_snaef == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean NTL values
        ntl_reyk = mean_reyk_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=reykjavik_region,
            scale=500,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo()
        
        ntl_snaef = mean_snaef_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=snaefellsnes_region,
            scale=500,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Reykjavík Mean NTL: {ntl_reyk}")
        print(f"Snæfellsnes Mean NTL: {ntl_snaef}")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if ntl_reyk is None or ntl_snaef is None:
            print("Calculation failed - invalid results.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif ntl_reyk > ntl_snaef:
            print(f"Reykjavík ({ntl_reyk:.4f}) > Snæfellsnes ({ntl_snaef:.4f})")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Reykjavík ({ntl_reyk:.4f}) ≤ Snæfellsnes ({ntl_snaef:.4f})")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
